messages:
Lina K.: starting a quick config-only change to diffuse late-afternoon spikes. no model updates. change-id cfg-2026-09-01-9. plan: small canary (3% / 40m). keys: routing.dispersal=diffuse, batching.max_wait_ms 25->13, tenant_throttle=0.93, request_deadline_ms 30000->31700. DeployBot: queued cfg-2026-09-01-9, canary=3%, window=40m. monitor: https://console.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-09-01-9 OpsBot: canary started at 1795002468, streaming logs to ops dash.
Diego: quick metric after 6m: p95 up ~16% on some canary hosts; batch p50 down 3->1.8. snippet: ```batching.hist p50=3 -> 1.8; p95_ms=185 -> 215``` Hannah: expected — reducing max_wait cuts coalescing. recommend pinning highest-throughput tenants so blast radius is tiny while we watch. Lina K.: agree. pin neo-shop,metrics-proxy,search-lite to cfg-prev now. DeployBot: pins applied: neo-shop,metrics-proxy,search-lite -> cfg-prev (action cfg-2026-09-01-pins)
Tom: add auto-rollback: trigger if errors>0.65% OR p95_delta>30% for 9m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK. DeployBot: rollback rule attached to cfg-2026-09-01-9. OpsBot: alert created and wired to paging on sustained spike (link https://ops.redwood/alerts/13221)
Diego: after pins the pinned tenants stable; remaining canary cohort p95 delta down to ~11%, errors 0.03%. propose shrink to 1.5% and extend to 90m for safety. Hannah: +1, and add a short cost note in the change doc: "small per-token increase expected where batching reduces; monitor cost-scan after ramp." Lina K.: adjusting canary to 1.5% / 90m and updating change doc with exact keys + pin list + cost note. DeployBot: canary adjusted to 1.5%/90m by Lina K.; changelog updated: "routing.dispersal diffused; batching.max_wait_ms 25->13; tenant_throttle 0.93; request_deadline_ms 30000->31700; pinned: neo-shop,metrics-proxy,search-lite; rollback rules attached; canary 1.5%/90m"
Tom: paste runbook snippet for quick rollback in the change doc: ```1) curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-09-01-9"}' 2) verify pins: GET /config/pins -> ensure listed tenants on cfg-prev 3) ping #eng-sre and #product 4) watch p95/errors for 30m 5) open incident if errors>1% for 10m``` Diego: I'll check KV cache pressure and batching histograms every 10m and post updates here. OpsBot: canary stable at 1.5% after 15m: p95_delta ~10%, errors 0.02%. next update in 25m. Lina K.: thanks team 1  keep other routing/QoS patches out of the queue until this finishes. if anyone sees anomalies >0.5% errors, call rollback and @channel immediately. reconvene after observation to discuss morning ramp. :white_check_mark:
